title: Nanofluidics; 3-D (5887831448)
author: National Institute of Standards and Technology
description: (A) Schematic of the NIST-Cornell nanofluidic device with complex 3-D surfaces. Each step of the staircase seen on the side marks a different depth within the chamber. The letter E shows the direction of the electric field used to move the nanoparticles through the device. The green balls are spheres with diameters of 100 nanometers whose size restricts them from moving into the shallower regions
